title: Mountain Moment: Scurry of Douglas Squirrels
licence: Public domain: work of the U.S. National Park Service (17 U.S.C. 105). The item page gives an NPS credit with no copyright symbol; NPS: "Multimedia credited to NPS without any copyright symbol are public domain."
description: Douglas squirrels are usually solitary and territorial, but young squirrels may stay with their mother for up to a year. This curious young Douglas squirrel wasn't sure about passing hikers, stomping its feet at a potential enemy. But was soon distracted by playing with its siblings. Date created 10/12/2018.
